sources.title: NYC Racial Equity Report submission guide
sources.use: Core packet structure; affordability, community context, fair-housing narrative and jobs reporting.
sources.inspection_extent: Printed pp. 1, 4–10 and 11–17; selected sections, not an applicability determination.
sources.limits: Research reference, not proof of equitable outcomes. Filename suggests October 2025; internal pages stamped July 1, 2025.

sources.title: HPD Equitable Development Data Explorer overview
sources.use: Baseline demographic/housing/equity context.
sources.inspection_extent: Official overview; underlying interactive tool/data exports not audited.
sources.limits: Interactive explorer was inaccessible through web reader; do not claim its current API/export is integrated.

sources.title: NYC DOHMH displacement-risk explanation
sources.use: Neighborhood vulnerability and displacement-risk context.
sources.inspection_extent: Official explanation.
sources.limits: Context index is not a project-caused displacement probability.

sources.title: CEQR Chapter 5: Socioeconomic Conditions, December 2025
sources.use: Counterfactuals; direct/indirect residential and business displacement.
sources.inspection_extent: Chapter introduction and assessment framework; selected sections.
sources.limits: Regulatory significance screening is not a community-benefit or ethical pass.

sources.title: CEQR Chapter 16: Transportation, December 2025
sources.use: Trips, capacity, pedestrians, safety, parking and goods movement.
sources.inspection_extent: Introduction and transportation assessment methods; selected sections.
sources.limits: Requires project inputs and agency judgment; not an automatic benefit calculator.

sources.title: HPD area median income and affordable rents
sources.use: Household-size-specific income and bedroom-specific rent references.
sources.inspection_extent: Live table headings and explanatory text.
sources.limits: Observed income heading 2026 and rent heading 2025. Pin each table vintage and utilities/program rules separately.

sources.title: 2023 NYC Housing and Vacancy Survey selected initial findings
sources.use: Rent burden, housing stock and household conditions.
sources.inspection_extent: Selected official findings; underlying microdata/weights not audited.
sources.limits: Do not substitute citywide survey estimates for parcel occupancy or ignore sampling uncertainty.

sources.title: HPD New Construction Finance term sheet
sources.use: Example of affordability depth/duration, public resources and delivery conditions.
sources.inspection_extent: Housing research agent reviewed July 2025 term sheet.
sources.limits: Program-specific rules and exceptions, not universal defaults.

sources.title: Tracking Transit-Oriented Development, Freemark/Su/Lo, December 2025
sources.use: TOD indicator taxonomy; planning, prioritization, delivery and evaluation distinctions.
sources.inspection_extent: Official 11-page PDF, selected framework and indicator sections.
sources.limits: No universal welfare score or causal estimator; publication landing page failed, PDF accessible.

sources.title: EPA Smart Location Mapping
sources.use: Location efficiency, transit access and reachable jobs benchmarks.
sources.inspection_extent: Official documentation overview.
sources.limits: Documented database release 2021; historical benchmark, not current service or causal project forecast.

sources.title: MTA developer resources
sources.use: GTFS feeds, schedule caveats and additional performance/accessibility sources.
sources.inspection_extent: Official feed descriptions read by transit researcher.
sources.limits: Bronx feed excludes Bx23/BxM; include MTA Bus Company. Temporary service changes incompletely represented.

sources.title: HUD/DOT Location Affordability Index v3 methodology
sources.use: Housing plus transportation household-cost modeling precedent.
sources.inspection_extent: Methods read by transit researcher.
sources.limits: Historical input vintages; not measured current household spending or portable project coefficients.

sources.title: USDOT: What is a benefit-cost analysis?
sources.use: Societal efficiency, benefits and lifecycle costs; distinguish financial/economic-impact analyses.
sources.inspection_extent: Official guidance overview.
sources.limits: Distribution and causal assumptions remain separate; avoid double counting jobs, appreciation and monetized travel benefits.

sources.title: MHCLG Appraisal Guide, updated February 18, 2026
sources.use: Counterfactual/additionality, distribution, uncertainty and double-counting discipline.
sources.inspection_extent: Introduction, externalities and place-based appraisal sections.
sources.limits: Applies to England. Borrow analytical structure, not NYC parameters, values or mandatory policy weights.

sources.title: ANHD Community Land Use Principles Toolkit
sources.use: Community-authored priorities and benchmarks for land-use proposals.
sources.inspection_extent: Introduction and approach; selected sections.
sources.limits: A stakeholder process framework, not an inferred consensus or universal objective function.

sources.title: Choice Neighborhoods: evaluation of outcomes and neighborhood impact
sources.use: People, housing and neighborhood outcomes; administrative data, surveys, interviews and synthetic controls.
sources.inspection_extent: Authors’ December 2024 publication summary; full 244-page report not exhaustively reviewed.
sources.limits: Program-specific retrospective evaluation, not a parcel forecast. Earlier HUD status page lagged completed-report publication.

sources.title: Supply Shock Versus Demand Shock: local effects of new housing
sources.use: Evidence on completed market-rate buildings and nearby rental markets.
sources.inspection_extent: Original research institution publication summary read by housing researcher.
sources.limits: Treatment is completed buildings in sampled contexts, not zoning permission; no off-the-shelf Bronx coefficient.

sources.title: The Effect of New Market-Rate Housing Construction on the Low-Income Housing Market
sources.use: Address-history moving chains and regional housing-market mechanism.
sources.inspection_extent: Institution-hosted working paper description and methods summary.
sources.limits: Counterfactual/model assumptions and geography/horizon matter; not direct local displacement prediction.

sources.title: Upzoning Chicago: author account of published study
sources.use: Transit-area zoning reform, property values and permitting.
sources.inspection_extent: Author’s account; full underlying data not reproduced.
sources.limits: No perceptible permitting response over study horizon; rents and individual displacement not measured. Not a universal null result.

sources.title: Chetty/Hendren/Katz: Moving to Opportunity neighborhood exposure
sources.use: Long-run neighborhood exposure effects for children in a voucher intervention.
sources.inspection_extent: Authors’ research page; housing researcher inspected author/institution paper sources.
sources.limits: Intervention, ages, populations and horizons differ from a new Bronx building or a station-distance measure.

sources.title: MTC Transit-Oriented Communities policy
sources.use: Agency example combining housing production, preservation/protection, station access and business stabilization.
sources.inspection_extent: Official policy description.
sources.limits: Bay Area policy applicability and weights do not transfer automatically to NYC.

sources.title: r5py travel-time matrix documentation
sources.use: Candidate implementation for OSM/GTFS-based travel-time matrices.
sources.inspection_extent: Official user documentation; not installed/executed.
sources.limits: Schedule-based modeled access, not reliability, service capacity or employment gains.

sources.title: OpenTripPlanner wheelchair-accessibility documentation
sources.use: Data and unknown-state handling for disability-accessible routing.
sources.inspection_extent: Official documentation; not installed/executed.
sources.limits: Disability accessibility and opportunity accessibility are different concepts; unknown accessibility is not verified access.

sources.title: CNT ETOD Social Impact Calculator description
sources.use: Adjacent building/location assessment product.
sources.inspection_extent: Official description only.
sources.limits: Full formulas, current live operation, transferability and open-source status not audited.

sources.title: Padeiro/Louro/Marques da Costa: TOD and gentrification systematic review
sources.use: Study-design and causal-inference limitations in TOD/gentrification literature.
sources.inspection_extent: Author publication abstract/available text read by transit researcher.
sources.limits: Review of historical studies; not a local causal forecast or guarantee of either harm or no harm.
